questions.korean: 만약 비가 오면 우산을 가져갈 거야.
answers: If it rains, I will bring an umbrella.
If it rains, I'll take an umbrella.
If you have time, let's watch a movie.
If we have time, let's watch a movie.

questions.korean: 만약 열심히 공부하면 시험을 통과할 거야.
answers: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
If you study hard, you'll pass the test.
If he calls, tell me.
If he calls, let me know.
If you are hungry, eat something.
If you're hungry, grab something to eat.
questions.explanation: grab something to eat = 뭔가 집어 먹다 (구어체)

answers: I don't know what to wear.
I'm not sure what to wear.
She knows how to drive.
She knows how to operate a car.

questions.korean: 나는 어디서 표를 사야 할지 모르겠어.
answers: I don't know where to buy tickets.
I'm not sure where to get tickets.
They decided when to leave.
They figured out when to depart.
He didn't know how to apologize.
He wasn't sure how to say sorry.

questions.korean: 나는 두 시간 전에 점심을 먹었어.
answers: I had lunch two hours ago.
I ate lunch two hours ago.
Do your homework before class.
Finish your homework before class.
I went for a walk after dinner.
I took a walk after dinner.
questions.explanation: go for a walk = take a walk = 산책하다

answers: I have been working here since last year.
I've worked here since last year.

questions.korean: 수업이 끝난 후에 뭐 할 거야?
answers: What are you going to do after class?
What will you do after class?
Can you open the window?
Could you open the window, please?
Do you want to have lunch together?
Would you like to have lunch with me?
questions.hint: Do you want to / Would you like to + 동사원형?
questions.explanation: Would you like to = 더 공손한 제안

answers: Do you want to go see a movie?
Shall we go to the movies?
questions.hint: Do you want to / Shall we + 동사원형?
questions.explanation: Shall we = 영국식 표현, 미국에서도 씀

answers: Could you please be quiet?
Can you keep it down, please?
Can you help me out?
Could you give me a hand?
I need to take the bus.
I have to catch the bus.
I need to make a decision.
I have to make up my mind.
questions.explanation: make up one's mind = 마음을 정하다

answers: Give her a call.
Call her.
questions.explanation: give someone a call = call someone (전화하다)

answers: I need to take a break.
I should take some rest.
I made a mistake.
I messed up.
I am so happy.
I'm really excited.
I was shocked by the news.
The news shocked me.
questions.explanation: The news shocked me = 능동 표현

answers: I am disappointed.
I feel let down.
I was surprised by the result.
The result surprised me.
He looks bored.
He seems bored.
questions.explanation: bored = 지루함을 느끼는, boring = 지루하게 만드는

answers: Have you ever been abroad?
Have you ever traveled overseas?
Have you ever gone skydiving?
Have you ever tried skydiving?

questions.korean: 나는 한 번도 도미노피자를 먹어본 적이 없어.
answers: I have never eaten Domino's Pizza.
I've never tried Domino's Pizza.

questions.korean: 그녀는 혼자 여행해 본 적이 있어.
answers: She has traveled alone before.
She has been traveling solo before.
Have you ever done bungee jumping?
Have you tried bungee jumping?
It takes 30 minutes to get there.
It takes about 30 minutes to get there.
The dress cost 200 dollars.
The dress was 200 dollars.
How long does it take to learn English?
How much time does it take to learn English?
questions.hint: How long does it take to + 동사원형?

answers: How much does it cost to fix this?
How much will it cost to repair this?
questions.hint: How much does it cost to + 동사원형?

questions.korean: 그 책을 읽는 데 사흘이 걸렸어.
answers: It took three days to read that book.
It took me three days to finish the book.
Today is March 15th.
It's March 15th today.
He is 25 years old.
He's 25.
These shoes are 50% off.
These shoes are on sale for 50% off.
The meeting is two and a half hours long.
The meeting lasts two and a half hours.
The store is open from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m.
The shop is open from 9 in the morning to 9 at night.
Long time no see!
It's been a while!
questions.explanation: It's been a while = 한동안 못 봤다

answers: I'm busy right now. Let's talk later.
I'm a bit busy. Can we talk later?
That's great!
Awesome!
Good for you!
questions.explanation: 상대방에게 좋은 일이 생겼을 때: Good for you!

answers: By the way, what are you doing this weekend?
Anyway, what are your plans for the weekend?
questions.explanation: by the way = 화제 전환 시 사용

answers: It's okay, don't worry about it.
No worries, it's fine.
questions.explanation: No worries는 호주식이지만 미국에서도 많이 씀
